13	# TagsInput
14	
15	A text input that converts entries into removable tags/chips. Supports add, edit, remove,
16	paste, and navigation between tags.
17	
18	## 1. State Machine
19	
20	### 1.1 States
21	
22	```rust

27	    Idle,
28	    /// The component is in a focused state.
29	    Focused,
30	    /// The component is in an editing tag state.
31	    EditingTag {
32	        /// The index of the tag being edited.

34	    },

88	> **IME composition:** This component tracks `is_composing: bool` in `Context`. During composition (`is_composing == true`), Enter key MUST NOT trigger `AddTag` and delimiter detection MUST be suppressed. See §IME in `03-accessibility.md`.
89	> See also [IME Composition Handling](10-input-components.md#ime-composition-protocol) for the shared input method editor behavior during text composition.

209	
210	### 1.5 TagsInput Inline Editing
211	
212	When `editable: true`, tags support inline editing via the following state/event additions:
213	
214	**Additional State**: The `EditingTag { index: usize }` state (already defined in the State enum)
215	becomes reachable. During this state, the tag at `index` renders an inline text input
216	pre-filled with the tag's current value.
217	
218	**Editing Context Fields**:
219	
220	```rust,no_check
221	// Already present in Context:
222	pub editing_tag: Option<usize>,     // Index of the tag currently being edited
223	
224	// Additional editing context (added to Context):
225	/// Draft text for the tag currently being edited. Initialized from the tag's
226	/// current value when editing starts; updated on each keystroke during edit.
227	pub editing_draft: String,
228	```
229	
230	**Editing Events**: The following events (already defined in the Event enum) drive the editing flow:
231	
232	| Event                         | Trigger                                                         | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                     |
233	| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
234	| `EditTag { index }`           | Enter key on focused tag, or double-click when `editable: true` | Transition to `EditingTag { index }`. Set `editing_tag = Some(index)`, `editing_draft` = current tag value. Focus the inline input.                                                          |
235	| `CommitEdit { index, value }` | Enter key during edit                                           | If `value` is non-empty and passes duplicate validation (when `allow_duplicates: false`), replace the tag at `index`. Transition back to `Focused`. Clear `editing_tag` and `editing_draft`. |
236	| `CancelEdit`                  | Escape key during edit                                          | Discard `editing_draft`. Transition back to `Focused`. Return focus to the tag at the editing index.                                                                                         |
237	| `InputChange(text)`           | Typing in the inline edit input                                 | Update `editing_draft` with the new text. No state transition.                                                                                                                               |
238	
239	**Keyboard Bindings During Editing**:
240	
241	| Key    | In `Focused` state (tag focused)                     | In `EditingTag` state        |
242	| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
243	| Enter  | Start edit (`EditTag { index }`) if `editable: true` | Commit edit (`CommitEdit`)   |
244	| Escape | —                                                    | Cancel edit (`CancelEdit`)   |
245	| Tab    | Move focus to next tag or input                      | Commit edit, then move focus |
246	
247	**Guard**: `EditTag`, `CommitEdit`, and `CancelEdit` events are rejected when `editable: false`,
248	`disabled: true`, or `readonly: true`.
249	
250	### 1.6 Full Machine Implementation
251	
252	```rust
253	/// The machine for the TagsInput component.
254	pub struct Machine;
255	
256	impl ars_core::Machine for Machine {
257	    type State = State;
258	    type Event = Event;
259	    type Context = Context;
260	    type Props = Props;
261	    type Api<'a> = Api<'a>;
262	    type Messages = Messages;
263	
264	    fn init(props: &Self::Props, env: &Env, messages: &Self::Messages) -> (Self::State, Self::Context) {
265	        let state = State::Idle;
266	        let locale = env.locale.clone();
267	        let messages = messages.clone();
268	        let ctx = Context {
269	            value: match &props.value {
270	                Some(v) => Bindable::controlled(v.clone()),
271	                None => Bindable::uncontrolled(props.default_value.clone()),
272	            },
273	            input_value: String::new(),
274	            focused: false,
275	            focus_visible: false,
276	            focused_tag: None,
277	            editing_tag: None,
278	            disabled: props.disabled,
279	            readonly: props.readonly,
280	            invalid: props.invalid,
281	            max: props.max,
282	            delimiter: props.delimiter.clone(),
283	            add_on_paste: props.add_on_paste,
284	            allow_duplicates: props.allow_duplicates,
285	            blur_behavior: props.blur_behavior,
286	            is_composing: false,
287	            name: props.name.clone(),
288	            locale,
289	            ids: ComponentIds::from_id(&props.id),
290	            messages,
291	        };
292	
293	        (state, ctx)
294	    }
295	
296	    fn transition(
297	        state: &Self::State,
298	        event: &Self::Event,
299	        ctx: &Self::Context,
300	        props: &Self::Props,
301	    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>> {
302	        if ctx.disabled || ctx.readonly {
303	            match event {
304	                Event::AddTag(_)
305	                | Event::RemoveTag(_)
306	                | Event::RemoveTagAtIndex(_)
307	                | Event::EditTag { .. }
308	                | Event::CommitEdit { .. }
309	                | Event::ClearAll
310	                | Event::Paste(_) => return None,
311	                _ => {}
312	            }
313	        }
314	
315	        match event {
316	            Event::AddTag(tag) => {
317	                let tag = tag.trim().to_string();
318	                if tag.is_empty() { return None; }
319	
320	                // Check max
321	                if let Some(max) = ctx.max {
322	                    if ctx.value.get().len() >= max { return None; }
323	                }
324	
325	                // Check duplicates
326	                if !ctx.allow_duplicates && ctx.value.get().contains(&tag) {
327	                    return None;
328	                }
329	
330	                let allow_dupes = ctx.allow_duplicates;
331	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
332	                    let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
333	                    if allow_dupes || !tags.contains(&tag) {
334	                        tags.push(tag);
335	                    }
336	                    ctx.value.set(tags);
337	                    ctx.input_value.clear();
338	                }))
339	            }
340	
341	            Event::RemoveTag(val) => {
342	                let val = val.clone();
343	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
344	                    let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
345	                    let removed_idx = tags.iter().position(|t| t == &val);
346	                    tags.retain(|t| t != &val);
347	                    ctx.value.set(tags.clone());
348	                    if tags.is_empty() {
349	                        ctx.focused_tag = None;
350	                    } else if let Some(idx) = removed_idx {
351	                        ctx.focused_tag = Some(idx.min(tags.len() - 1));
352	                    }
353	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_tag", |ctx, _props, _send| {
354	                    if let Some(idx) = ctx.focused_tag {
355	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
356	                        let tag_id = ctx.ids.item("tag", &idx);
357	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&tag_id);
358	                    }
359	                    no_cleanup()
360	                })))
361	            }
362	
363	            Event::RemoveTagAtIndex(idx) => {
364	                let idx = *idx;
365	                if idx >= ctx.value.get().len() { return None; }
366	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
367	                    let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
368	                    if idx < tags.len() {
369	                        tags.remove(idx);
370	                        ctx.value.set(tags.clone());
371	                        if tags.is_empty() {
372	                            ctx.focused_tag = None;
373	                        } else {
374	                            ctx.focused_tag = Some(idx.min(tags.len() - 1));
375	                        }
376	                    }
377	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_tag", |ctx, _props, _send| {
378	                    if let Some(idx) = ctx.focused_tag {
379	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
380	                        let tag_id = ctx.ids.item("tag", &idx);
381	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&tag_id);
382	                    }
383	                    no_cleanup()
384	                })))
385	            }
386	
387	            Event::EditTag { index } => {
388	                if *index >= ctx.value.get().len() { return None; }
389	                let idx = *index;
390	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::EditingTag { index: idx }).apply(move |ctx| {
391	                    ctx.editing_tag = Some(idx);
392	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_edit_input", |ctx, _props, _send| {
393	                    if let Some(idx) = ctx.editing_tag {
394	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
395	                        let edit_id = ctx.ids.item("tag-edit-input", &idx);
396	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&edit_id);
397	                    }
398	                    no_cleanup()
399	                })))
400	            }
401	
402	            Event::CommitEdit { index, value } => {
403	                let idx = *index;
404	                let val = value.trim().to_string();
405	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
406	                    if val.is_empty() {
407	                        let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
408	                        if idx < tags.len() {
409	                            tags.remove(idx);
410	                            ctx.value.set(tags);
411	                        }
412	                    } else {
413	                        let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
414	                        if idx < tags.len() {
415	                            tags[idx] = val;
416	                            ctx.value.set(tags);
417	                        }
418	                    }
419	                    ctx.editing_tag = None;
420	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_input", |ctx, _props, _send| {
421	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
422	                    let input_id = ctx.ids.part("input");
423	                    platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
424	                    no_cleanup()
425	                })))
426	            }
427	
428	            Event::CancelEdit => {
429	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(|ctx| {
430	                    ctx.editing_tag = None;
431	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_input", |ctx, _props, _send| {
432	                    let platform = use_platform_effects();
433	                    let input_id = ctx.ids.part("input");
434	                    platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
435	                    no_cleanup()
436	                })))
437	            }
438	
439	            Event::Focus { is_keyboard } => {
440	                let is_kb = *is_keyboard;
441	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Focused).apply(move |ctx| {
442	                    ctx.focused = true;
443	                    ctx.focus_visible = is_kb;
444	                    ctx.focused_tag = None;
445	                }))
446	            }
447	
448	            Event::Blur if matches!(state, State::EditingTag { .. }) => {
449	                let idx = match state {
450	                    State::EditingTag { index } => *index,
451	                    _ => 0,
452	                };
453	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx| {
454	                    // Commit the in-progress edit before transitioning
455	                    ctx.editing_tag = None;
456	                    ctx.focused = false;
457	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
458	                    ctx.focused_tag = None;
459	                }))
460	            }
461	
462	            Event::Blur => {
463	                // Respect blur_behavior: Add creates a tag, Clear discards input.
464	                let input_trimmed = ctx.input_value.trim().to_string();
465	                let should_attempt_add = ctx.blur_behavior == BlurBehavior::Add;
466	                let can_add = should_attempt_add
467	                    && !input_trimmed.is_empty()
468	                    && ctx.max.map_or(true, |m| ctx.value.get().len() < m)
469	                    && (ctx.allow_duplicates || !ctx.value.get().contains(&input_trimmed));
470	                let tag_to_add = if can_add { Some(input_trimmed) } else { None };
471	
472	                Some(TransitionPlan::to(State::Idle).apply(move |ctx| {
473	                    if let Some(tag) = tag_to_add {
474	                        let mut tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
475	                        tags.push(tag);
476	                        ctx.value.set(tags);
477	                    }
478	                    ctx.input_value.clear();
479	                    ctx.focused = false;
480	                    ctx.focus_visible = false;
481	                    ctx.focused_tag = None;
482	                }))
483	            }
484	
485	            Event::InputChange(val) => {
486	                let val = val.clone();
487	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
488	                    ctx.input_value = val;
489	                    ctx.focused_tag = None;
490	                }))
491	            }
492	
493	            Event::Paste(text) => {
494	                if !ctx.add_on_paste {
495	                    let text = text.clone();
496	                    return Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
497	                        ctx.input_value = text;
498	                    }));
499	                }
500	                let delimiter = ctx.delimiter.clone();
501	                let max = ctx.max;
502	                let allow_duplicates = ctx.allow_duplicates;
503	                let parts: Vec<String> = text.split(&delimiter)
504	                    .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
505	                    .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())
506	                    .collect();
507	                let current_tags = ctx.value.get().clone();
508	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
509	                    let mut tags = current_tags;
510	                    for part in parts {
511	                        if max.map_or(true, |m| tags.len() < m)
512	                            && (allow_duplicates || !tags.contains(&part))
513	                        {
514	                            tags.push(part);
515	                        }
516	                    }
517	                    ctx.value.set(tags);
518	                    ctx.input_value.clear();
519	                }))
520	            }
521	
522	            Event::ClearAll => {
523	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
524	                    ctx.value.set(Vec::new());
525	                    ctx.input_value.clear();
526	                }))
527	            }
528	
529	            Event::FocusPrevTag => {
530	                let len = ctx.value.get().len();
531	                if len == 0 { return None; }
532	                let current_tag = ctx.focused_tag;
533	                let new_idx = match current_tag {
534	                    Some(idx) if idx > 0 => idx - 1,
535	                    Some(0) => 0,
536	                    None => len - 1,
537	                    _ => 0,
538	                };
539	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
540	                    ctx.focused_tag = Some(new_idx);
541	                }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_tag", |ctx, _props, _send| {
542	
543	                    if let Some(idx) = ctx.focused_tag {
544	                        let platform = use_platform_effects();
545	                        let tag_id = ctx.ids.item("tag", &idx);
546	                        platform.focus_element_by_id(&tag_id);
547	                    }
548	                    no_cleanup()
549	                })))
550	            }
551	
552	            Event::FocusNextTag => {
553	                let len = ctx.value.get().len();
554	                let current_tag = ctx.focused_tag;
555	                match current_tag {
556	                    Some(idx) if idx + 1 < len => {
557	                        let next = idx + 1;
558	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(move |ctx| {
559	                            ctx.focused_tag = Some(next);
560	                        }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_tag", |ctx, _props, _send| {
561	                            if let Some(idx) = ctx.focused_tag {
562	                                let platform = use_platform_effects();
563	                                let tag_id = ctx.ids.item("tag", &idx);
564	                                platform.focus_element_by_id(&tag_id);
565	                            }
566	                            no_cleanup()
567	                        })))
568	                    }
569	                    Some(_) => {
570	                        // Past last tag → focus input
571	                        Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| {
572	                            ctx.focused_tag = None;
573	                        }).with_effect(PendingEffect::new("focus_input", |ctx, _props, _send| {
574	                            let platform = use_platform_effects();
575	                            let input_id = ctx.ids.part("input");
576	                            platform.focus_element_by_id(&input_id);
577	                            no_cleanup()
578	                        })))
579	                    }
580	                    None => None,
581	                }
582	            }
583	
584	            Event::CompositionStart => {
585	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = true; }))
586	            }
587	            Event::CompositionEnd => {
588	                Some(TransitionPlan::context_only(|ctx| { ctx.is_composing = false; }))
589	            }
590	
591	            _ => None,
592	        }
593	    }
594	
595	    fn connect<'a>(
596	        state: &'a Self::State,
597	        ctx: &'a Self::Context,
598	        props: &'a Self::Props,
599	        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
600	    ) -> Self::Api<'a> {
601	        Api { state, ctx, props, send }
602	    }
603	}
604	```

654	    /// Attributes for the root container.

662	        if self.ctx.invalid { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-invalid"), true); }

705	    /// Attributes for a tag element.
706	    pub fn tag_attrs(&self, index: usize) -> AttrMap {
707	        let tag_id = self.ctx.ids.item("tag", index);
708	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
709	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Tag { index }.data_attrs();
710	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
711	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
712	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-index"), index.to_string());
713	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, tag_id);
714	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Role, "row");
715	        if let Some(value) = self.ctx.value.get().get(index) {
716	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Label), value);
717	        }
718	        if self.ctx.disabled {
719	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
720	        }
721	        let is_focused = self.ctx.focused_tag == Some(index);
722	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::TabIndex, if is_focused { "0" } else { "-1" });
723	        if self.ctx.focus_visible && is_focused {
724	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-focus-visible"), true);
725	        }
726	        if self.ctx.editing_tag == Some(index) {
727	            attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Data("ars-editing"), true);
728	        }
729	        if !self.ctx.disabled && !self.ctx.readonly {
730	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Description),
731	                (self.ctx.messages.delete_hint)(&self.ctx.locale));
732	        }
733	        attrs
734	    }

780	    /// Attributes for the new-tag input element.
781	    pub fn input_attrs(&self) -> AttrMap {
782	        let mut attrs = AttrMap::new();
783	        let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = Part::Input.data_attrs();
784	        attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
785	        attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
786	        attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Id, self.ctx.ids.part("input"));
787	        if let Some(ref placeholder) = self.props.placeholder {
788	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Placeholder, placeholder);
789	        }
790	        if self.ctx.disabled { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::Disabled, true); }
791	        if self.ctx.readonly { attrs.set_bool(HtmlAttr::ReadOnly, true); }
792	        if self.props.required { attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Required), "true"); }
793	        if let Some(max_len) = self.props.max_length {
794	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::MaxLength, max_len.to_string());
795	        }
796	        // Wire aria-describedby to error-message (first) and description parts.
797	        let mut describedby_parts: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
798	        if self.ctx.invalid {
799	            describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("error-message"));
800	        }
801	        describedby_parts.push(self.ctx.ids.part("description"));
802	        if !describedby_parts.is_empty() {
803	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::DescribedBy), describedby_parts.join(" "));
804	        }
805	        // Disable input when max tags reached
806	        if self.ctx.max.map_or(false, |m| self.ctx.value.get().len() >= m) {
807	            attrs.set(HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Disabled), "true");
808	        }
809	        attrs
810	    }

882	    /// Handle keydown on the input element.
883	    pub fn on_input_keydown(&self, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
884	        if self.ctx.is_composing { return; }
885	        match data.key {
886	            KeyboardKey::Enter => {
887	                if !self.ctx.input_value.trim().is_empty() {
888	                    (self.send)(Event::AddTag(self.ctx.input_value.clone()));
889	                }
890	            }
891	            KeyboardKey::Backspace => {
892	                if self.ctx.input_value.is_empty() {
893	                    (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevTag);
894	                }
895	            }
896	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => {
897	                if self.ctx.input_value.is_empty() {
898	                    (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevTag);
899	                }
900	            }
901	            KeyboardKey::Escape => {
902	                (self.send)(Event::InputChange(String::new()));
903	            }
904	            _ => {}
905	        }
906	    }
907	
908	    /// Handle keydown on a focused tag.
909	    pub fn on_tag_keydown(&self, index: usize, data: &KeyboardEventData) {
910	        match data.key {
911	            KeyboardKey::Backspace | KeyboardKey::Delete => {
912	                (self.send)(Event::RemoveTagAtIndex(index));
913	            }
914	            KeyboardKey::ArrowLeft => (self.send)(Event::FocusPrevTag),
915	            KeyboardKey::ArrowRight => (self.send)(Event::FocusNextTag),
916	            KeyboardKey::Escape => {
917	                (self.send)(Event::FocusNextTag); // deselect → focus input
918	            }
919	            KeyboardKey::Enter => {
920	                if self.props.editable {
921	                    (self.send)(Event::EditTag { index });
922	                }
923	            }
924	            _ => {}
925	        }
926	    }

962	            Part::HiddenInput => self.hidden_input_attrs(),

971	
972	| Part               | Selector                                                            | Element    | Notes                |
973	| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | -------------------- |
974	| `Root`             | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="root"]`               | `<div>`    |                      |
975	| `Label`            | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="label"]`              | `<label>`  |                      |
976	| `Control`          | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="control"]`            | `<div>`    | Wraps tags + input   |
977	| `Tag`              | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="tag"]`                | `<span>`   | `data-ars-index`     |
978	| `TagText`          | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="tag-text"]`           | `<span>`   |                      |
979	| `TagDeleteTrigger` | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="tag-delete-trigger"]` | `<button>` | ×/close icon         |
980	| `TagEdit`          | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="tag-edit"]`           | `<input>`  | Visible in edit mode |
981	| `Input`            | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="input"]`              | `<input>`  | New tag entry        |
982	| `ClearTrigger`     | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="clear-trigger"]`      | `<button>` | Remove all           |
983	| `HiddenInput`      | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="hidden-input"]`       | `<input>`  | Form value           |
984	| `Description`      | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="description"]`        | `<div>`    |                      |
985	| `ErrorMessage`     | `[data-ars-scope="tags-input"][data-ars-part="error-message"]`      | `<div>`    |                      |

987	## 3. Accessibility
988	
989	### 3.1 ARIA Roles, States, and Properties
990	
991	| Property           | Element            | Value                                                                            |
992	| ------------------ | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
993	| `role`             | `Control`          | `grid` (enables proper AT navigation between tags and their delete actions)      |
994	| `aria-labelledby`  | `Control`          | Label id                                                                         |
995	| `role`             | `Tag`              | `row`                                                                            |
996	| `role`             | `TagText`          | `gridcell`                                                                       |
997	| `role`             | `TagDeleteTrigger` | `gridcell` (contains the remove button)                                          |
998	| `aria-describedby` | `Input`            | Description + ErrorMessage ids                                                   |
999	| `aria-label`       | `Tag`              | `"{value}"`                                                                      |
1000	| `aria-disabled`    | `Tag`              | When tag or group is disabled                                                    |
1001	| `aria-label`       | `TagDeleteTrigger` | `"Remove {value}"`                                                               |
1002	| `aria-label`       | `ClearTrigger`     | `"Remove all tags"`                                                              |
1003	| `aria-describedby` | `Tag`              | ID of shared visually hidden text: "Press Delete to remove" (localized via i18n) |
1004	
1005	### 3.2 Keyboard Interaction
1006	
1007	| Key          | In Input                           | On Tag                     |
1008	| ------------ | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- |
1009	| Enter        | Add current input as tag           | —                          |
1010	| Backspace    | If empty: focus last tag           | Remove tag                 |
1011	| Delete       | —                                  | Remove tag                 |
1012	| ArrowLeft    | If cursor at start: focus last tag | Focus previous tag         |
1013	| ArrowRight   | —                                  | Focus next tag or input    |
1014	| Escape       | Clear input                        | Deselect tag → focus input |
1015	| Double-click | —                                  | Enter edit mode on tag     |
1016	
1017	### 3.3 Screen Reader Announcements
1018	
1019	When a tag is removed, screen reader users must be informed of the removal and the
1020	resulting focus location:
1021	
1022	- **Live region announcement**: On tag deletion, emit an `aria-live="polite"` announcement:
1023	  `"Removed {tag_label}"` (localized via `Messages`).
1024	- **Tag `aria-label`**: Each Tag part MUST have `aria-label="{tag_label}, press Delete to remove"`
1025	  (localized via `Messages.delete_hint`), combining the tag value with the
1026	  removal instruction.
1027	- **Max count reached**: When `ctx.value.get().len() >= ctx.max.unwrap_or(usize::MAX)`,
1028	  announce `"Maximum of {max} tags reached"` via the live region. The input SHOULD also
1029	  set `aria-disabled="true"` to indicate no more tags can be added.
1030	- **Focus management after removal**: Focus follows the existing `focus_tag` effect —
1031	  moves to the adjacent tag (same index, clamped to `len - 1`), or to the input if no
1032	  tags remain. This behavior is already implemented in the `RemoveTag` and
1033	  `RemoveTagAtIndex` transitions above.
1034	
1035	## 4. Internationalization
1036	
1037	### 4.1 Messages
1038	
1039	```rust
1040	#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
1041	pub struct Messages {
1042	    /// Template for tag delete trigger label (default: "Remove {value}")
1043	    pub remove_tag_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&str, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1044	    /// Clear all trigger label (default: "Remove all tags")
1045	    pub clear_all_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1046	    /// Visually hidden instruction (default: "Press Delete to remove")
1047	    pub delete_hint: MessageFn<dyn Fn(&Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1048	    /// Count label when `max_tags` is set (default: "{current} of {max} tags").
1049	    pub count_label: MessageFn<dyn Fn(usize, usize, &Locale) -> String + Send + Sync>,
1050	}
1051	
1052	impl Default for Messages {
1053	    fn default() -> Self {
1054	        Self {
1055	            remove_tag_label: MessageFn::new(|value, _locale| format!("Remove {}", value)),
1056	            clear_all_label: MessageFn::static_str("Remove all tags"),
1057	            delete_hint: MessageFn::static_str("Press Delete to remove"),
1058	            count_label: MessageFn::new(|current, max, _locale| format!("{} of {} tags", current, max)),
1059	        }
1060	    }
1061	}
1062	
1063	impl ComponentMessages for Messages {}
1064	```
1065	
1066	All hardcoded `aria-label` values in `TagDeleteTrigger` and `ClearTrigger` MUST read from this struct.
1067	
1068	- **Delimiter**: Default `,` — may be configured per locale (some locales use `;`).
1069	- **Tag labels**: `"Remove {value}"` — localized via `Messages.remove_tag_label`.
1070	- **RTL**: Tag order renders right-to-left; ArrowLeft/Right reversed visually.
1071	- **Max count message**: `"{current} of {max} tags"` — localized with plural rules via `Messages.count_label`.
1072	
1073	## 5. Form Integration
1074	
1075	- **Hidden input**: The `HiddenInput` part is a `<input type="hidden">` whose `value` is the joined tag list (`ctx.value.get().join(&ctx.delimiter)`). The `name` attribute is set from `Props.name`.
1076	- **Validation states**: `aria-invalid="true"` on `Root` when `invalid=true`. The `ErrorMessage` part is linked via `aria-describedby` on the `Input`.
1077	- **Per-tag validation**: Use the forms foundation `Validator` trait (`07-forms.md`) via the `Field` wrapper. The `FieldValue::Text` variant receives the joined tag string. For per-tag granularity, register a custom `Validator` that splits the value by the delimiter and validates each segment individually:
1078	
1079	```rust
1080	use ars_forms::{Validator, FieldValue, ValidationContext, ValidationResult, ValidationError, ValidationErrorCode};
1081	
1082	struct PerTagValidator<F: Fn(&str) -> Result<(), String>> {
1083	    delimiter: String,
1084	    validate_tag: F,
1085	}
1086	
1087	impl<F: Fn(&str) -> Result<(), String> + Send + Sync> Validator for PerTagValidator<F> {
1088	    fn validate(&self, value: &FieldValue, _ctx: &ValidationContext) -> ValidationResult {
1089	        let text = match value {
1090	            FieldValue::Text(t) => t.as_str(),
1091	            _ => return ValidationResult::Valid,
1092	        };
1093	        for tag in text.split(&self.delimiter).map(str::trim).filter(|t| !t.is_empty()) {
1094	            if let Err(reason) = (self.validate_tag)(tag) {
1095	                return ValidationResult::Invalid(vec![ValidationError {
1096	                    message: reason.clone(),
1097	                    code: ValidationErrorCode::Custom(reason),
1098	                }]);
1099	            }
1100	        }
1101	        ValidationResult::Valid
1102	    }
1103	}
1104	```
1105	
1106	- **Required validation**: When `required == true`, at least one tag must be present. The `HiddenInput` has `required` set and the empty string value triggers native constraint validation.
1107	- **Max tags**: Enforced by the state machine via `Props.max`. No form-level validator needed.
1108	- **Duplicate prevention**: Enforced by the state machine when `Props.allow_duplicates == false`. No form-level validator needed.
1109	- **Reset behavior**: On form reset, the adapter restores `value` to `default_value`.
1110	- **Disabled/readonly propagation**: When inside a `Field` or `Fieldset`, the adapter merges `disabled`/`readonly` from `FieldCtx` per `07-forms.md` §12.6.
1111	
1112	## 6. Library Parity
1113	
1114	> Compared against: Ark UI (`TagsInput`), React Aria (`TagGroup`).
1115	
1116	Note: Ark UI's `TagsInput` and React Aria's `TagGroup` differ significantly in scope. Ark UI's is an input-focused component (type to add tags); React Aria's is a display-focused component (tag list with remove). ars-ui's `TagsInput` covers both use cases.
1117	
1118	### 6.1 Props
1119	
1120	| Feature                       | ars-ui                          | Ark UI                             | React Aria                             | Notes                                             |
1121	| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
1122	| Controlled/uncontrolled value | `value` / `default_value`       | `value` / `defaultValue`           | `selectedKeys` / `defaultSelectedKeys` | React Aria uses selection model, not input model  |
1123	| Max tags                      | `max`                           | `max`                              | --                                     | --                                                |
1124	| Disabled                      | `disabled`                      | `disabled`                         | --                                     | --                                                |
1125	| Read-only                     | `readonly`                      | `readOnly`                         | --                                     | --                                                |
1126	| Invalid                       | `invalid`                       | `invalid`                          | --                                     | --                                                |
1127	| Required                      | `required`                      | `required`                         | --                                     | --                                                |
1128	| Delimiter                     | `delimiter`                     | `delimiter`                        | --                                     | React Aria has no input (display-only)            |
1129	| Add on paste                  | `add_on_paste`                  | `addOnPaste`                       | --                                     | --                                                |
1130	| Allow duplicates              | `allow_duplicates`              | --                                 | --                                     | ars-ui exclusive                                  |
1131	| Max length per tag            | `max_length`                    | `maxLength`                        | --                                     | --                                                |
1132	| Editable (inline edit)        | `editable`                      | `editable`                         | --                                     | --                                                |
1133	| Blur behavior                 | `blur_behavior` (`Add`/`Clear`) | `blurBehavior` (`clear`/`add`)     | --                                     | --                                                |
1134	| Name (form)                   | `name`                          | `name`                             | --                                     | --                                                |
1135	| Placeholder                   | `placeholder`                   | `placeholder`                      | --                                     | --                                                |
1136	| Input value                   | --                              | `inputValue` / `defaultInputValue` | --                                     | Ark UI has controlled input value                 |
1137	| Validate (custom)             | --                              | `validate`                         | --                                     | Ark UI has per-tag validation callback            |
1138	| Selection mode                | --                              | --                                 | `selectionMode`                        | React Aria exclusive (tag selection for bulk ops) |
1139	| Disabled keys                 | --                              | --                                 | `disabledKeys`                         | React Aria exclusive                              |
1140	| Disallow empty selection      | --                              | --                                 | `disallowEmptySelection`               | React Aria exclusive                              |
1141	| Escape key behavior           | --                              | --                                 | `escapeKeyBehavior`                    | React Aria exclusive                              |
1142	| On remove                     | --                              | --                                 | `onRemove`                             | React Aria fires on tag removal                   |
1143	
1144	**Gaps:** None. Ark UI's `inputValue` controlled input is not needed -- ars-ui tracks input value in context. Ark UI's `validate` callback is handled via ars-ui's form integration (`PerTagValidator` in §5). React Aria's `TagGroup` is fundamentally a different component (display-only tag list) and its selection/removal props do not apply to the input-focused `TagsInput`.
1145	
1146	### 6.2 Anatomy
1147	
1148	| Part              | ars-ui              | Ark UI              | React Aria               | Notes                                     |
1149	| ----------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
1150	| Root              | `Root`              | `Root`              | `TagGroup`               | --                                        |
1151	| Label             | `Label`             | `Label`             | `Label`                  | --                                        |
1152	| Control           | `Control`           | `Control`           | `TagList`                | Wraps tags + input                        |
1153	| Input             | `Input`             | `Input`             | --                       | React Aria has no input                   |
1154	| Item (tag)        | `Item`              | `Item`              | `Tag`                    | --                                        |
1155	| ItemPreview       | `ItemPreview`       | `ItemPreview`       | --                       | Tag visual container                      |
1156	| ItemText          | `ItemText`          | `ItemText`          | --                       | --                                        |
1157	| ItemDeleteTrigger | `ItemDeleteTrigger` | `ItemDeleteTrigger` | --                       | React Aria handles remove via render prop |
1158	| ItemInput         | `ItemInput`         | `ItemInput`         | --                       | Inline edit input                         |
1159	| ClearTrigger      | `ClearTrigger`      | `ClearTrigger`      | --                       | --                                        |
1160	| HiddenInput       | `HiddenInput`       | `HiddenInput`       | --                       | Form submission                           |
1161	| Description       | `Description`       | --                  | `Text[slot=description]` | --                                        |
1162	| ErrorMessage      | `ErrorMessage`      | --                  | `FieldError`             | --                                        |
1163	
1164	**Gaps:** None.
1165	
1166	### 6.3 Events
1167	
1168	| Callback         | ars-ui                    | Ark UI               | React Aria          | Notes                       |
1169	| ---------------- | ------------------------- | -------------------- | ------------------- | --------------------------- |
1170	| Value change     | via `Bindable`            | `onValueChange`      | --                  | --                          |
1171	| Input change     | `Event::InputChange`      | `onInputValueChange` | --                  | --                          |
1172	| Highlight change | via `Context.focused_tag` | `onHighlightChange`  | --                  | --                          |
1173	| Invalid tag      | --                        | `onValueInvalid`     | --                  | ars-ui uses form validation |
1174	| Selection change | --                        | --                   | `onSelectionChange` | React Aria exclusive        |
1175	| Remove           | `Event::RemoveTag`        | --                   | `onRemove`          | --                          |
1176	
1177	**Gaps:** None.
1178	
1179	### 6.4 Features
1180	
1181	| Feature                    | ars-ui | Ark UI | React Aria        |
1182	| -------------------------- | ------ | ------ | ----------------- |
1183	| Add tags by typing         | Yes    | Yes    | No (display-only) |
1184	| Remove tags                | Yes    | Yes    | Yes               |
1185	| Inline editing             | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1186	| Paste support              | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1187	| Keyboard navigation (tags) | Yes    | Yes    | Yes               |
1188	| Max tags limit             | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1189	| Delimiter support          | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1190	| Blur behavior              | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1191	| Form integration           | Yes    | Yes    | No                |
1192	| IME composition            | Yes    | --     | --                |
1193	| RTL support                | Yes    | Yes    | Yes               |
1194	
1195	**Gaps:** None.
1196	
1197	### 6.5 Summary
1198	
1199	- **Overall:** Full parity -- no gaps identified.
1200	- **Divergences:** (1) React Aria's `TagGroup` is a display/selection component, not an input component -- it does not support adding tags by typing; ars-ui's `TagsInput` covers both input and display use cases; (2) ars-ui uses form-level validation (`PerTagValidator`) instead of a component-level `validate` callback; (3) ars-ui tracks IME composition state for CJK input support.
1201	- **Recommended additions:** None.

```rust
pub trait Machine: Sized + 'static {
    type State: Clone + Debug + PartialEq;
    type Event: Clone + Debug;
    type Context: Clone + Debug;
    type Props: Clone + PartialEq + HasId;
    type Messages: ComponentMessages + Clone + Default + 'static;
    type Effect: EffectName;
    type Api<'a>: ConnectApi where Self: 'a;

    fn init(
        props: &Self::Props,
        env: &Env,
        messages: &Self::Messages,
    ) -> (Self::State, Self::Context);

    fn transition(
        state: &Self::State,
        event: &Self::Event,
        context: &Self::Context,
        props: &Self::Props,
    ) -> Option<TransitionPlan<Self>>;

    fn connect<'a>(
        state: &'a Self::State,
        context: &'a Self::Context,
        props: &'a Self::Props,
        send: &'a dyn Fn(Self::Event),
    ) -> Self::Api<'a>;

    fn on_props_changed(
        _old: &Self::Props, 
        _new: &Self::Props
    ) -> Vec<Self::Event> { Vec::new() }

    fn initial_effects(
        _state: &Self::State,
        _context: &Self::Context,
        _props: &Self::Props,
    ) -> Vec<PendingEffect<Self>> { Vec::new() }
}

## Test Conventions in `ars-components`

I've explored the test setup across inline tests, snapshot tests, spec-conformance tests, proptest state machines, and coverage thresholds. Here are the concrete examples and conventions:

### 1. **Unit Tests: Inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` Pattern**

**Location:** Per-component unit tests live directly in the component file under `#[cfg(test)] mod tests {...}`.

**Example from Checkbox** (`/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-242/crates/ars-components/src/input/checkbox/mod.rs:817`):

    use ars_core::{AriaAttr, ConnectApi, Env, HtmlAttr, Service, StrongSend, callback};
    use insta::assert_snapshot;

    use super::*;

    fn test_props() -> Props {
        Props {
            id: "terms".to_string(),
            ..Props::default()
        }

        assert_eq!(service.state(), &State::Unchecked);
        assert_eq!(service.context().checked.get(), &State::Unchecked);
        assert!(!service.context().disabled);
        // ... more assertions
    }
}

            .item(key(2), "Banana", Item { label: "Banana".into() })

    }

        assert!(result.state_changed);
        assert!(service.context().open);
        assert_eq!(service.context().input_value.get(), "ap");

### 2. **Snapshot Tests with Insta (`insta::assert_snapshot`)**

**How `AttrMap` is Serialized for Snapshotting:**

`AttrMap` derives `Debug` (and conditionally `serde::Serialize` with the `serde` feature). The snapshot tests use a custom `snapshot_attrs()` helper that formats the `AttrMap` using Debug:

```rust
fn snapshot_attrs(attrs: &AttrMap) -> String {
    format!("{attrs:#?}")  // Or: format!("{:#?}", attrs.iter_attrs().collect::<Vec<_>>())
}
```

**Snapshot Test Pattern** (Checkbox, line 1701):

```rust

fn checkbox_root_unchecked_snapshot() {

    assert_snapshot!(
        "checkbox_root_unchecked",
        snapshot_attrs(&service.connect(&|_| {}).root_attrs())

}

### 3. **Spec-Conformance Tests**

**Location:** `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-242/crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/`

These tests verify that the `Part` enum anatomy matches the spec's declared parts. They are **separate from component files**, organized by category.

**Helper** (`spec_conformance/helper.rs`):

```rust
pub(crate) fn assert_anatomy<P>(expected_scope: &'static str, expected_parts: &[(P, &'static str)])
where
    P: ComponentPart + core::fmt::Debug + PartialEq,
{
    assert_eq!(P::scope(), expected_scope, "Part::scope() must match spec §3 anatomy");

    let actual = P::all();
    let actual_names = actual.iter().map(ComponentPart::name).collect::<Vec<_>>();
    let expected_names = expected_parts.iter().map(|(_, name)| *name).collect::<Vec<_>>();

    assert_eq!(actual_names, expected_names, "Part::all() name list must equal spec §3 anatomy");
    assert_eq!(actual.len(), expected_parts.len(), "Part::all() length must match");

    for (actual_part, (expected_part, expected_name)) in actual.iter().zip(expected_parts) {
        assert_eq!(actual_part.name(), *expected_name);
        assert_eq!(actual_part, expected_part);
    }

    if let Some((first_expected, _)) = expected_parts.first() {
        assert_eq!(&P::ROOT, first_expected, "Part::ROOT must equal the first spec-declared part");
    }
}
```

**Example Test** (Checkbox, `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-242/crates/ars-components/tests/spec_conformance/input/checkbox.rs`):

```rust
use ars_components::input::checkbox;
use crate::helper::assert_anatomy;

#[test]
fn checkbox_anatomy_matches_spec() {
    assert_anatomy(
        "checkbox",
        &[
            (checkbox::Part::Root, "root"),
            (checkbox::Part::Label, "label"),
            (checkbox::Part::Control, "control"),
            (checkbox::Part::Indicator, "indicator"),
            (checkbox::Part::HiddenInput, "hidden-input"),
            (checkbox::Part::Description, "description"),
            (checkbox::Part::ErrorMessage, "error-message"),
        ],
    );
}
```

What's checked:
- `Part::scope()` matches the spec's `data-ars-scope` token.
- `Part::all()` returns exactly the declared parts in declared order.
- Each part's `name()` round-trips with the kebab-case token.
- `Part::ROOT` equals the first declared part (workspace convention).

### 4. **Proptest State Machines**

**Location:** `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-242/crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/`

**Common Configuration** (`common.rs`):

```rust
#[must_use]
pub(super) fn proptest_config() -> Config {
    let cases = std::env::var("PROPTEST_CASES")
        .ok()
        .and_then(|v| v.parse().ok())
        .unwrap_or(1000);

    Config {
        cases,
        failure_persistence: Some(Box::new(FileFailurePersistence::Direct(
            "proptest-regressions/state-machines.txt",
        ))),
        ..Config::default()
    }
}
```

Reads `PROPTEST_CASES` env var (defaults to 1000 local, 10,000 nightly CI). Seeds persist to single `proptest-regressions/state-machines.txt` file (committed per proptest convention).

**Example Proptest** (Checkbox, `/Users/ericson/Workspace/Rust/ars-ui.worktrees/impl-242/crates/ars-components/tests/proptest_state_machines/input/checkbox.rs`):

```rust
use ars_components::input::checkbox;
use ars_core::{AriaAttr, Env, HtmlAttr, Service};
use proptest::prelude::*;

fn arb_checkbox_state() -> impl Strategy<Value = checkbox::State> {
    prop_oneof![
        Just(checkbox::State::Unchecked),
        Just(checkbox::State::Checked),
        Just(checkbox::State::Indeterminate),
    ]
}

fn arb_checkbox_props() -> impl Strategy<Value = checkbox::Props> {
    (
        prop::option::of(arb_checkbox_state()),
        arb_checkbox_state(),
        any::<bool>(),
        // ... more fields
    )
        .prop_map(|(checked, default_checked, disabled, ...)| {
            checkbox::Props {
                id: "checkbox".to_string(),
                checked,
                default_checked,
                disabled,
                // ...
            }
        })
}

fn arb_checkbox_event() -> impl Strategy<Value = checkbox::Event> {
    prop_oneof![
        Just(checkbox::Event::Toggle),
        Just(checkbox::Event::Check),
        Just(checkbox::Event::Uncheck),
        Just(checkbox::Event::Reset),
        prop::option::of(arb_checkbox_state()).prop_map(checkbox::Event::SetValue),
        // ... more events
    ]
}

proptest! {
    #![proptest_config(crate::common::proptest_config())]

    #[test]
    #[ignore = "proptest — nightly extended-proptest job"]
    fn proptest_checkbox_event_sequences_preserve_invariants(
        props in arb_checkbox_props(),
        events in prop::collection::vec(arb_checkbox_event(), 0..128),
    ) {
        let mut service = Service::<checkbox::Machine>::new(
            props,
            &Env::default(),
            &checkbox::Messages,
        );

        for event in events {
            drop(service.send(event));

            let state = *service.state();

            prop_assert_eq!(service.context().ids.id(), "checkbox");
            prop_assert_eq!(service.context().checked.get(), &state);

            let control_attrs = service.connect(&|_| {}).control_attrs();

            prop_assert_eq!(
                control_attrs.get(&HtmlAttr::Aria(AriaAttr::Checked)),
                Some(aria_checked_token(state))
            );
        }
    }
}
```

### 5. **Machine + Service + Api Interaction Pattern**

This is the core pattern for constructing and testing components:

**Construct a Service:**
```rust
let service = Service::<Machine>::new(props, &Env::default(), &Messages::default());
```

**Send Events:**
```rust
let result = service.send(Event::Toggle);
assert!(result.state_changed);
```

**Get Api and Call Connect:**
```rust
let api = service.connect(&|_| {});  // The closure receives emitted events
```

**Access Part Attributes:**
```rust
let root_attrs = api.root_attrs();
let input_attrs = api.input_attrs();
let control_attrs = api.control_attrs();
```

**Helper Pattern for Event Capture** (from Combobox):

```rust
fn dispatch_api(service: &mut Service<Machine>, f: impl FnOnce(&Api<'_>)) {
    let events = RefCell::new(Vec::new());
    {
        let send = |event| {
            events.borrow_mut().push(event);
        };
        let api = service.connect(&send);
        f(&api);
    }
    for event in events.into_inner() {
        send_event(service, event);
    }
}

fn api_events(service: &Service<Machine>, f: impl FnOnce(&Api<'_>)) -> Vec<Event> {
    let events = RefCell::new(Vec::new());
    {
        let send = |event| {
            events.borrow_mut().push(event);
        };
        let api = service.connect(&send);
        f(&api);

#[test]
fn listbox_anatomy_matches_spec() {

        "listbox",

            (listbox::Part::Content, "content"),

//! Property-based tests for selection component state machines.

use std::{collections::BTreeSet, time::Duration};

use ars_collections::{Collection, CollectionBuilder, Key, selection};
use ars_components::selection::{
    autocomplete, combobox, context_menu, listbox, menu, menu_bar, segment_group, select,
};
use ars_core::{AriaAttr, ConnectApi as _, Env, HtmlAttr, Service};
use proptest::{prelude::*, test_runner::TestCaseResult};

fn key(value: &'static str) -> Key {
    Key::str(value)
}

fn arb_key() -> impl Strategy<Value = Key> {
    prop_oneof![
        Just(key("alpha")),
        Just(key("bravo")),
        Just(key("charlie")),
        Just(key("delta")),
    ]
}

fn arb_disabled_keys() -> impl Strategy<Value = BTreeSet<Key>> {
    prop::collection::vec(arb_key(), 0..3).prop_map(|keys| keys.into_iter().collect())
}

fn arb_segment_group_event() -> impl Strategy<Value = segment_group::Event> {
    prop_oneof![
        arb_key().prop_map(segment_group::Event::SelectValue),
        Just(segment_group::Event::FocusNext),
        Just(segment_group::Event::FocusPrev),
        Just(segment_group::Event::FocusFirst),
        Just(segment_group::Event::FocusLast),
        arb_key().prop_map(|item| segment_group::Event::FocusItem {
            item,
            is_keyboard: true,
        }),
        Just(segment_group::Event::Blur),
    ]
}

fn segment_group_items(disabled: &BTreeSet<Key>) -> Vec<segment_group::Segment> {
    [key("alpha"), key("bravo"), key("charlie"), key("delta")]
        .into_iter()
        .map(|value| {
            let is_disabled = disabled.contains(&value);

            segment_group::Segment::new(value).disabled(is_disabled)
        })
        .collect()
}

Two are architecturally forced (non-negotiable): the `Machine` trait requires a `type Effect` (the spec omits it and uses string names), and agnostic `ars-components` cannot call the adapter-only `use_platform_effects()` — the canonical pattern (per `pin_input`) is a typed `Effect` enum resolved by the adapter via `ctx`. ## Context

GitHub issue #242 (Epic #221, Agnostic selection components, 8 pts, Unit test tier) asks for the
framework-agnostic core of `TagsInput`: a text input that converts entries into removable
tag chips with add/remove/reorder, duplicate prevention, max-tags, inline editing, paste,
collection-style keyboard navigation, IME handling, and form integration. Adapter components
(Leptos/Dioxus) are explicitly **out of scope** for this task.

Dependency Epic #53 (Collections) is **closed** — unblocked.

The component does **not** yet exist (`crates/ars-components/src/selection/tags_input/` absent).

by every other selection component (combobox, listbox, select, etc.).

amendments below land in `spec/components/selection/tags-input.md` **in this same PR**:

   `Machine::Effect` associated type (the trait requires `type Effect: EffectName`) and its
   effect closures call `use_platform_effects()` / `focus_element_by_id()` — both live in the
   *adapter* crates and are unavailable in agnostic `ars-components`. Canonical pattern
   (`crates/ars-components/src/input/pin_input/mod.rs`, `Effect::FocusCell`): define a typed
   `Effect` enum and emit `PendingEffect::named(Effect::X)`; the adapter resolves DOM focus from
   `ctx` (`focused_tag` / `editing_tag`). Replace all `use_platform_effects()` effect closures.

2. **Duplicate `Api` methods.** §1.7 defines `on_input_focus`, `on_input_blur`,
   `on_input_change`, `on_tag_delete`, `on_clear_click` twice (≈ lines 639-652 and 871-939) —
   will not compile. Keep one set (the richer "Event handlers" block) and amend the spec.

3. **`editing_draft` (confirmed: add & fully wire).** §1.5 says Context carries
   `editing_draft: String` but §1.3/§1.6 never declare/wire it. Add the field; `EditTag` inits it
   from the tag value, `InputChange`-while-`EditingTag` updates it, `CommitEdit`/`CancelEdit`
   clear it. Agnostic core owns the inline-edit value. Amend §1.3 + §1.6.

4. **Live-region announcements (confirmed: add Messages + effect).** §3.3 describes

   field set in the relevant transitions, and an `Effect::Announce` (adapter surfaces
   `ctx.live_message`). Amend §1.3, §1.6, §1.7, §2 anatomy, §3.3, §4.1.

5. **Delimiter-on-type (issue requires an "add on comma" test).** §1.6's `InputChange` only sets
   `input_value`; only `Paste` splits on the delimiter. The §1.2 IME note ("delimiter detection
   MUST be suppressed during composition") implies delimiter detection happens during typing. Wire
   `InputChange` (when not composing and not editing) to split completed `delimiter`-separated
   segments into tags and keep the trailing remainder as `input_value`. Amend §1.6.

6. **Validation.** The issue lists an "on_validate callback" test, but the spec routes validation
   to the forms layer (§5 `PerTagValidator`) — core `Props` has no validate callback (the
   `// Change callbacks provided by the adapter layer` comment). Honor the spec: test the `invalid`
   prop / `aria-invalid` / ErrorMessage wiring instead of inventing a core callback.

- Imports from `ars_core`: `AriaAttr, AttrMap, Bindable, ComponentIds, ComponentMessages,
  ComponentPart, ConnectApi, Env, HtmlAttr, KeyboardKey, Locale, MessageFn, PendingEffect,
  TransitionPlan, no_cleanup` (+ `ConnectApi as _`, `Service` in tests). `KeyboardEventData` from
  `ars_interactions`. Core trait/impl signatures confirmed in `crates/ars-core/src/lib.rs`.
- `Bindable<Vec<String>>` is valid (blanket `impl<T: Clone+PartialEq+Debug> BindableValue for T`).
- `TransitionPlan::context_only(f)` / `::to(state).apply(f)` / `.with_effect(PendingEffect::named(..))`.
- `ComponentIds::part(&str)` and `item(&str, &impl Display)` (accepts `usize`/`&usize`).
- `AttrMap::new()/set/set_bool`; all `HtmlAttr`/`AriaAttr` variants used in §1.7 exist.
- `MessageFn::new(closure)` and `MessageFn::static_str(&'static str)`.
- Effect convention: typed enum + `PendingEffect::named(Effect::X)`, adapter reads `ctx`
  (model: `crates/ars-components/src/input/pin_input/mod.rs`).
- Callback-style effects with props closures: `crates/ars-components/src/input/text_field/mod.rs`
  (`focus_change_effect`). LiveRegion part + on-demand text Api method:
  `crates/ars-components/src/selection/combobox/mod.rs` (`live_region_attrs`, `results_count_text`).

## Design summary

- **States** (§1.1): `Idle`, `Focused`, `EditingTag { index }`.
- **Context** (§1.3 + amendments): spec fields **plus** `editing_draft: String` and
  `live_message: String`. `value: Bindable<Vec<String>>` (Vec preserves insertion order; dup
  prevention in transition logic — tags are positional strings, not keyed `Collection` items, so
  parts key on `index: usize` exactly as the spec models).
- **Effect** enum: `FocusTag` (focus `ctx.focused_tag`), `FocusInput`, `FocusEditInput`
  (focus `ctx.editing_tag`), `Announce` (surface `ctx.live_message`).
- **Part** enum (13): `Root, Label, Control, Tag{index}, TagText{index}, TagDeleteTrigger{index},
  TagEdit{index}, Input, ClearTrigger, HiddenInput, Description, ErrorMessage, LiveRegion`.
- **Transitions**: implement §1.6 exactly except the reconciliations — disabled/readonly guards;
  `AddTag` (trim, max, dup); `RemoveTag`/`RemoveTagAtIndex` (set `live_message` via
  `removed_announcement`, refocus adjacent tag via `FocusTag`, or `FocusInput`+`Announce` when
  empty); `EditTag`/`CommitEdit`/`CancelEdit` (editable/disabled/readonly guard, `editing_draft`);
  `Focus`/`Blur` (+ `EditingTag` blur commit + `BlurBehavior`); `InputChange` (delimiter-on-type
  split when not composing/editing; else `editing_draft`); `Paste`; `ClearAll`; `FocusPrevTag`/
  `FocusNextTag`; `CompositionStart`/`End`; `AddTag` blocked by max → `Announce` max-reached.
- **Api / connect** (§1.7): one method per part returning `AttrMap` exactly per §1.6 (grid pattern:
  `Control` role=grid, `Tag` role=row, `TagText`/`TagDeleteTrigger` role=gridcell), plus
  `count_text()`, `live_region_attrs()`, an announcement-text accessor, deduped event handlers, and
  `impl ConnectApi { fn part_attrs }`.

## Test plan (TDD — write tests first, per issue "Tests to add first")

Inline unit tests in `mod.rs` (drive via `Service::<Machine>::new(props, &Env::default(),
&Messages::default())`, `service.send(event)`, `service.connect(&send)`):
add-on-Enter; add-on-comma (delimiter-on-type); remove via delete button (`RemoveTag`) and via
Backspace (empty input → focus last; focused tag → remove); arrow-key tag navigation; duplicate
prevention; max-tags limit (+ max-reached announcement); `invalid` state attrs + ErrorMessage;
inline edit (`EditTag`/`CommitEdit`/`CancelEdit` + `editing_draft`); paste split; clear-all; IME
suppression (Enter/delimiter no-op while composing); blur behavior (`Add`/`Clear`); removal
announcement live region.

Snapshot tests (`insta::assert_snapshot!` over a `snapshot_attrs(&attrs)` Debug helper, matching
the checkbox/combobox pattern): every anatomy part **and** each output-affecting state/prop/context
branch — root (default/disabled/readonly/invalid/focused), control (±max), tag
(focused/editing/disabled/focus-visible), tag_text, tag_delete_trigger (±disabled), tag_edit
(editing/hidden), input (placeholder/disabled/readonly/required/max_length/at-max/invalid-describedby),
clear_trigger (±disabled), hidden_input (name/required/disabled), description, error_message
(visible/hidden), live_region. Commit `.snap` fixtures; must pass
`cargo insta test --unreferenced=reject`. Attach `snapshot-reviewed` label to the PR.

Spec-conformance: `tags_input_anatomy_matches_spec` enumerating all 13 parts in declared order.

Proptest: `arb_*` props/events + an `#[ignore]` sequence test asserting invariants — no duplicates
when `!allow_duplicates`, `len <= max`, `focused_tag`/`editing_tag` in range, `hidden_input` value
== `value.join(delimiter)`, stable id.

## Verification

1. `cargo test -p ars-components tags_input` (unit + snapshot) and
   `cargo insta test -p ars-components --unreferenced=reject` — review/accept new `.snap` files.
2. `cargo test -p ars-components --test spec_conformance tags_input_anatomy_matches_spec`.
3. `cargo test -p ars-components --test proptest_state_machines` (sanity; `#[ignore]` proptest is
   nightly-driven).
4. Run the mandatory `post-implementation-audit` skill (all three phases — spec/impl drift,
   iterative "anything missing?", test coverage); fix every finding in this PR.
5. After user approval: `cargo xci-fast` (fmt, clippy, unit/integration/adapter, snapshot-count,
   native coverage ≥ 90/90 for `ars-components`) — fix failures before push.
6. Open PR targeting `main` with `Closes #242`; add `snapshot-reviewed` label; then run the
   `waiting-for-codex-review` skill loop until Codex 👍.

## Out of scope

Leptos/Dioxus adapter components, adapter tests, widgets examples, E2E fixtures (those are a
separate adapter task per `docs/implementation/adapter-component-delivery.md`). Mutation testing is
nightly-driven, not a delivery gate.

pub struct SendResult<M: Machine> {
    /// Whether any state change occurred during this send cycle.
    pub state_changed: bool,

    /// Whether any context mutation occurred (via `plan.apply`).
    ///
    /// Adapters should trigger re-render when `state_changed || context_changed`.
    pub context_changed: bool,

    /// Effects that the adapter must set up.
    pub pending_effects: Vec<PendingEffect<M>>,

    /// Named effects to cancel. The adapter runs their cleanup closures
    /// immediately, before setting up any new `pending_effects`.
    pub cancel_effects: Vec<M::Effect>,

    /// Whether the event queue was truncated due to hitting `MAX_DRAIN_ITERATIONS`.
    pub truncated: bool,

    /// Number of consecutive context-only iterations at the end of drain.
    ///
    /// Useful for diagnostics — a high trailing value may indicate a
    /// `context_only` + `then_send` feedback loop.
    pub context_change_count: usize,
}

    let [(scope_attr, scope_val), (part_attr, part_val)] = part.data_attrs();
    attrs.set(scope_attr, scope_val);
    attrs.set(part_attr, part_val);
    attrs

impl<T: BindableValue> Bindable<T> {
    /// Creates a controlled bindable owned by the parent.
    ///
    /// Both the controlled and internal fields are initialized to the given value.
    /// The component reads the controlled value via [`get`](Self::get).
    #[must_use]
    pub fn controlled(value: T) -> Self {
        Self {
            internal: value.clone(),
            controlled: Some(value),
        }
    }

    /// Creates an uncontrolled bindable managed by the component.
    ///
    /// There is no external controlled value; [`get`](Self::get) returns the
    /// internal value which can be updated via [`set`](Self::set).
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn uncontrolled(default: T) -> Self {
        Self {
            controlled: None,
            internal: default,
        }
    }

    /// Returns a reference to the current value.
    ///
    /// Returns the controlled value if set, otherwise the internal value.
    #[must_use]
    pub fn get(&self) -> &T {
        self.controlled.as_ref().unwrap_or(&self.internal)
    }

    /// Returns `true` if this value is controlled by the parent.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn is_controlled(&self) -> bool {
        self.controlled.is_some()
    }

    /// Updates the internal value.
    ///
    /// In controlled mode, this becomes the pending internal value that is
    /// revealed once the bindable returns to uncontrolled mode.
    pub fn set(&mut self, value: T) {
        self.internal = value;
    }

    /// Pushes a new controlled value from the parent.
    ///
    /// This should be called when the parent's controlled prop changes.
    pub fn sync_controlled(&mut self, value: Option<T>) {
        self.controlled = value;
    }

    /// Returns a mutable reference to the internal value.
    ///
    /// Use for in-place mutations on collection types to avoid cloning.
    /// **Warning:** For controlled bindables, mutating the internal value has no
    /// effect on what [`get`](Self::get) returns (it returns the controlled value).
    pub const fn get_mut_owned(&mut self) -> &mut T {
        &mut self.internal
    }

    /// Returns the internal (pending) value, ignoring any controlled override.
    ///
    /// Unlike [`get`](Self::get) — which returns the controlled value when the
    /// bindable is controlled — this always returns the value staged via
    /// [`set`](Self::set), i.e. the value the component would commit. Use this
    /// when reporting a just-computed result to the parent (for example the
    /// final value passed to an `on_change_end` callback at the end of a drag):
    /// in controlled mode the parent has not yet round-tripped the new value
    /// back through its prop, so [`get`](Self::get) would still return the stale
    /// controlled value.
    #[must_use]
    pub const fn pending(&self) -> &T {
        &self.internal
    }
}

The real bug: a stray `CommitEdit`/`CancelEdit` in a non-editing state mutates tags and dangles focus. These events are only valid while editing. Let me guard them.

{

  "old_string": "        // While editing a tag inline, list-mutating and tag-navigation events are\n        // unreachable from the editing UI. Ignoring them keeps the edit atomic\n        // (the user must commit, cancel, or blur first) so `editing_tag` and the\n        // `EditingTag` state never dangle past a structural change.\n        if matches!(state, State::EditingTag { .. }) {\n            match event {\n                Event::AddTag(_)\n                | Event::RemoveTag(_)\n                | Event::RemoveTagAtIndex(_)\n                | Event::EditTag { .. }\n                | Event::Paste(_)\n                | Event::ClearAll\n                | Event::FocusPrevTag\n                | Event::FocusNextTag => return None,\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }",
  "new_string": "        if matches!(state, State::EditingTag { .. }) {\n            // While editing a tag inline, list-mutating and tag-navigation events\n            // are unreachable from the editing UI. Ignoring them keeps the edit\n            // atomic (the user must commit, cancel, or blur first) so `editing_tag`\n            // and the `EditingTag` state never dangle past a structural change.\n            match event {\n                Event::AddTag(_)\n                | Event::RemoveTag(_)\n                | Event::RemoveTagAtIndex(_)\n                | Event::EditTag { .. }\n                | Event::Paste(_)\n                | Event::ClearAll\n                | Event::FocusPrevTag\n                | Event::FocusNextTag => return None,\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        } else {\n            // `CommitEdit` / `CancelEdit` only make sense while editing; a stray\n            // one in another state would otherwise mutate the list and dangle focus.\n            match event {\n                Event::CommitEdit { .. } | Event::CancelEdit => return None,\n                _ => {}\n            }\n        }"
}

1251	### 3.3 Screen Reader Announcements
1252	
1253	When a tag is removed, screen reader users must be informed of the removal and the
1254	resulting focus location:
1255	
1256	- **Live region announcement**: On tag deletion, emit an `aria-live="polite"` announcement:
1257	  `"Removed {tag_label}"` (localized via `Messages`).
1258	- **Tag `aria-label`**: Each Tag part MUST have `aria-label="{tag_label}, press Delete to remove"`
1259	  (localized via `Messages.delete_hint`), combining the tag value with the
1260	  removal instruction.
1261	- **Max count reached**: When `ctx.value.get().len() >= ctx.max.unwrap_or(usize::MAX)`,
1262	  announce `"Maximum of {max} tags reached"` via the live region. The input SHOULD also
1263	  set `aria-disabled="true"` to indicate no more tags can be added.
1264	- **Focus management after removal**: Focus follows the existing `focus_tag` effect —
1265	  moves to the adjacent tag (same index, clamped to `len - 1`), or to the input if no
1266	  tags remain. This behavior is already implemented in the `RemoveTag` and
1267	  `RemoveTagAtIndex` transitions above.
1268

216	### 1.5 TagsInput Inline Editing
217	
218	When `editable: true`, tags support inline editing via the following state/event additions:
219	
220	**Additional State**: The `EditingTag { index: usize }` state (already defined in the State enum)
221	becomes reachable. During this state, the tag at `index` renders an inline text input
222	pre-filled with the tag's current value.
223	
224	**Editing Context Fields**:
225	
226	```rust,no_check
227	// Already present in Context:
228	pub editing_tag: Option<usize>,     // Index of the tag currently being edited
229	
230	// Additional editing context (added to Context):
231	/// Draft text for the tag currently being edited. Initialized from the tag's
232	/// current value when editing starts; updated on each keystroke during edit.
233	pub editing_draft: String,
234	```
235	
236	**Editing Events**: The following events (already defined in the Event enum) drive the editing flow:
237	
238	| Event                         | Trigger                                                         | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                     |
239	| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
240	| `EditTag { index }`           | Enter key on focused tag, or double-click when `editable: true` | Transition to `EditingTag { index }`. Set `editing_tag = Some(index)`, `editing_draft` = current tag value. Focus the inline input.                                                          |
241	| `CommitEdit { index, value }` | Enter key during edit                                           | If `value` is non-empty and passes duplicate validation (when `allow_duplicates: false`), replace the tag at `index`. Transition back to `Focused`. Clear `editing_tag` and `editing_draft`. |
```

242	| `CancelEdit`                  | Escape key during edit                                          | Discard `editing_draft`. Transition back to `Focused`. Return focus to the tag at the editing index.                                                                                         |
243	| `InputChange(text)`           | Typing in the inline edit input                                 | Update `editing_draft` with the new text. No state transition.                                                                                                                               |
244	
245	**Keyboard Bindings During Editing**:
246	
247	| Key    | In `Focused` state (tag focused)                     | In `EditingTag` state        |
248	| ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------- |
249	| Enter  | Start edit (`EditTag { index }`) if `editable: true` | Commit edit (`CommitEdit`)   |
250	| Escape | —                                                    | Cancel edit (`CancelEdit`)   |
251	| Tab    | Move focus to next tag or input                      | Commit edit, then move focus |
252	
253	**Guard**: `EditTag`, `CommitEdit`, and `CancelEdit` events are rejected when `editable: false`,
254	`disabled: true`, or `readonly: true`.
